Crypto “Wrench Attacks” Push Exchanges and Executives to Spend Big on Security

content:
RECAP: Five years ago today, crypto had its worst single-day crash in history.

$BTC -30%.
$ETH -40%.
$DOGE -45%.

$ 8B+ liquidated in 24 hours. 775,000 traders wiped out.

The catalyst sequence:

@elonmusk pulled Tesla's $BTC payments on May 12.

China's PBOC banned financial institutions from crypto on May 18.

@Binance, @Coinbase and @RobinhoodApp all went down as traders rushed the exits.
